newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Saab Auto U.S. June car sales up 15 pct to 3,761.
newsitem.headline: Saab Auto U.S. June car sales up 15 pct to 3,761.

text.p: Swedish car maker Saab Automobile AB said on Wednesday its sales in the United States rose 15 percent to 3,761 vehicles in June compared to June 1996.
In June 2,812 cars sold in the United States were the Saab 900 model. Some 1,072 were the cabriolet model, which was a record number, Saab Automobile said in a statement.
So far this year Saab Automobile's U.S. car sales total 13,897, an increase of two percent compared to the same 1996 period, Saab Auto said.
Saab Automobile AB is owned by Swedish investment group Investor AB and U.S. car maker General Motors.
